```{r}
#| eval: false

# Requirements:(https://github.com/carlosivanr/dfmtbx)
# 1. Relies on custom functions in the 
# [dfmtbx] package. May need to set GITHUB_PAT.
#   - usethis::create_github_token()
#   - gitcreds::gitcreds_set()
#   - ctrl + shift + v to paset token
#   - renv::install("carlosivanr/dfmtbx")
# 2. RedCap API stored as environmental variable
#   - Generate API Token in RedCap project
#   - Save token as system environmental variable
#   - use the env var in the dfm_tbx function
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
```


```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(magrittr, include = "%<>%")
library(gtsummary)
library(dfmtbx)
```

```{r}
# Demographics come from a separate report and project so the number of 
# participants in the demographics table may not match up with the number
# of evaluations in the remainder of the report.

env_var <- "med_int_demographics" # string variable containing RedCap API token
report_id <- 184648 # numeric variable containing the RedCap report id

# Skeleton to pull RedCAP data as raw, label, and headers
label <- pull_redcap_report(
  Sys.getenv(env_var),
  report_id,
  "label",
  "raw",
  "false"
)

raw <- pull_redcap_report(
  Sys.getenv(env_var),
  report_id,
  "raw",
  "raw",
  "false"
)

field_text <- pull_redcap_report(
  Sys.getenv(env_var),
  report_id,
  "raw",
  "label",
  "false"
)
```

# Demographics
```{r}
data <- bind_cols(
  label %>% select(age_v2),

  raw %>% select(
    gender___1:gender___5,
    race_eth___1:race_eth___8,
  ),

  label %>% select(primary_lang_v2:language_num_v2)
)

data %<>%
  mutate(across(gender___1:race_eth___8, ~ factor(.x, levels = c(0, 1)))) %>%
  mutate(across(language_num_v2, ~ factor(.x)))


old_col_names <- colnames(data)

# Strip the _v2 suffixes
new_col_names <- str_replace(old_col_names, "_v2", "")

colnames(data) <- new_col_names

field_labels <- c(
  "Age", "Female", "Male", "Non-binary", "Prefer to self describe gender", "Choose not to disclose gender",
  "Asian/Asian American", "Black/African American", "Indigenous North American/American Indian and Alaska Native",
  "Indigenous other", "Latino/a", "White/Caucasian", "Prefer to self describe race/ethnicity", "Choose not to disclose race/ethnicity", "Primary language", "Number of additional proficient languages"
)
```


```{r}
data %>%
  tbl_summary(
    type = list("age" ~ "continuous"),
    label = list(
      "age" ~ "Age",
      "gender___1" ~ field_labels[2],
      "gender___2" ~ field_labels[3],
      "gender___3" ~ field_labels[4],
      "gender___4" ~ field_labels[5],
      "gender___5" ~ field_labels[6],
      "race_eth___1" ~ field_labels[7],
      "race_eth___2" ~ field_labels[8],
      "race_eth___3" ~ field_labels[9],
      "race_eth___4" ~ field_labels[10],
      "race_eth___5" ~ field_labels[11],
      "race_eth___6" ~ field_labels[12],
      "race_eth___7" ~ field_labels[13],
      "race_eth___8" ~ field_labels[14],
      "primary_lang" ~ field_labels[15],
      "language_num" ~ field_labels[16]
    ),
    value = list(
      "gender___1" ~ 1,
      "gender___2" ~ 1,
      "gender___3" ~ 1,
      "gender___4" ~ 1,
      "gender___5" ~ 1,
      "race_eth___1" ~ 1,
      "race_eth___2" ~ 1,
      "race_eth___3" ~ 1,
      "race_eth___4" ~ 1,
      "race_eth___5" ~ 1,
      "race_eth___6" ~ 1,
      "race_eth___7" ~ 1,
      "race_eth___8" ~ 1

    )
  )
```

# Evaluations

```{r}
env_var <- "med_int_evals" # string variable containing RedCap API token
report_id <- 184959 # numeric variable containing the RedCap report id

# Skeleton to pull RedCAP data as raw, label, and headers
evals_label <- pull_redcap_report(
  Sys.getenv(env_var),
  report_id,
  "label",
  "raw",
  "false"
)

evals_raw <- pull_redcap_report(
  Sys.getenv(env_var),
  report_id,
  "raw",
  "raw",
  "false"
)

evals_field_text <- pull_redcap_report(
  Sys.getenv(env_var),
  report_id,
  "raw",
  "label",
  "false"
)
```


## Evaluator and resident
```{r}
evals_label %>%
  select(evaluator, resident) %>%
  tbl_summary()
```

# Evaluator feedback
```{r}
evals_label %>%
  select(resident, date, comments) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  format_gt_tbl()
```

## Evaluation track, setting, and interpreter type
```{r}
evals_label %>%
  select(track, setting, interp) %>% #, firstperson, statements) %>%
  tbl_summary()
```

## How consistently did the learner speak with the patient in the first person
```{r}
evals_label %<>%
  mutate(
    across(firstperson:jargon, ~ factor(.x, levels = c(
        "Always",
        "Mostly",
        "Sometimes",
        "Rarely",
        "Never"))))
```

```{r}
evals_label %>%
  select(firstperson) %>%
  tbl_summary()
```                                                                                                                       

## How consistently did the learner use short, digestible statements?
```{r}
evals_label %>%
  select(statements) %>%
  tbl_summary()
```

## How consistently did the learner avoid medical jargon?
```{r}
evals_label %>%
  select(jargon) %>%
  tbl_summary()
```

## Did the learner introduce themselves to the interpreter?
```{r}
evals_label %<>%
  mutate(across(intro_self:intro_interp, ~ factor(.x, levels = c("No", "Yes"))))
```

```{r}
evals_label %>%
  select(intro_self) %>%
  tbl_summary(type = everything() ~ "categorical")
```                                                                  

## Did the learner allow the interpreter to introduce themselves?
```{r}
evals_label %>%
  select(intro_interp) %>%
  tbl_summary(type = everything() ~ "categorical")
```

## Some encounters involve special context that an interpreter may not be able to discern over the phone, such as a patient who is hard of hearing or has a hoarse voice, multiple family members or providers in the room, or a sensitive or difficult conversation. If applicable to this encounter, did the learner introduce the context to the interpreter?
```{r}
evals_label %>%
  select(context) %>%
  tbl_summary(type = everything() ~ "categorical")
```
